facts.text: Adelphi guarantees a $10,000 annual tuition rate for eligible undergraduate transfer students from New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, and Massachusetts who have at least a 3.6 GPA.

sources.title: Ways to Save | Honors College - Adelphi University
sources.quote: $10,000* total tuition per year for students transferring to Adelphi. students must have a minimum GPA of 3.6 and reside in NY, NJ, CT or MA.
